linkedin.text: Over the past few years, I’ve worked with Taiwan’s civil society community to analyze targeted attacks and strengthen threat detection. A few weeks ago, I joined the Open Culture Foundation Digital Security Forum 2026 to discuss nation-state cyber threats targeting civil society.
